metadata.title: About Us — Prozeso
metadata.description: Meet the team behind Prozeso. Born at Google Dublin to close the gap between Excel and SAP for companies of 10 to 200 employees.

hero.title: The story behind <highlight>Prozeso</highlight>
hero.subtitle: We met at Google's offices in Dublin with a clear vision: there's a whole segment of companies stuck between manual chaos and corporate software, and nobody is really serving them.
hero.originParagraph1: Three professionals: marketing, engineering, and strategy. Comparing notes in Dublin. We agreed on one thing: growing companies are stuck with tools that don't grow with them, and the alternatives are out of reach.
hero.originParagraph2: Spanish companies of 10 to 200 employees, with processes living in people's heads, spreadsheets, and WhatsApp messages. The tools they can afford are too rigid to truly fit. The tools that fit are too heavy, too slow and too expensive to ever adopt.
hero.originParagraph3: That day we decided to build the team that company never had: people who would truly understand its business and build, from scratch, the automation it needed.

team.title: The team
team.subtitle: Three co-founders, one mission: be the technical team small and mid-sized businesses never had, designing and building their automation from start to finish.

ceo.name: Cristian Guzmán
ceo.description: Leads customer conversations and the commercial direction. Previously in marketing, now selling what he himself decided was the problem.

cto.name: Alejandro González
cto.description: Designs and builds every automation from scratch. Previously an engineer in banking and consumer products, now writing the code that used to run on spreadsheets and WhatsApp.

sales.name: Carles Vineta
sales.description: Backs the commercial strategy. 6+ years in operations at companies like the ones we serve. Makes sure the decisions hold up in reality, not just on the slide.
